reason: 99 euros a month is nothing if it really does the marketing for me, but 'AI co-workers' sounds like every other tool that hands me drafts I end up rewriting. I'd book the free demo, but I wouldn't pay this month before I've seen it actually run on my own business.
objection: Will it really post, follow up leads and answer customers by itself, or will I end up babysitting it and fixing its drafts? And 100 credits a month means nothing to me, so I can't tell how much work that actually covers.
would_change_my_mind: The Customer Success team sets it up on my real tools during the demo and shows me a month of posts and lead follow-ups it ran with no help from me, ideally with a money-back first month.
